c_padcool: Wet-pad cooling at the hottest hour
c_strip2: Evaporative cooling works best in dry air.

chat_bad_provider: LLM_PROVIDER in .env must be 'anthropic' or 'openai_compatible'. The dashboard works without the assistant.
chat_error: The assistant is unavailable right now. The plan and dashboard above are still correct.
chat_footer: The AI explains and compares; you make the final decision.
chat_hello: Ask me anything about this plan.
chat_hello_sub: I explain the numbers and can re-run them. Write in English or Arabic.
chat_no_base_url: Set LLM_BASE_URL in your .env file to your open-source model server. The dashboard works without it.
chat_no_key: The assistant needs an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your .env file, or an open-source model (see README). The dashboard works without it.
chat_no_llm_key: The assistant needs LLM_API_KEY (your OpenRouter key) in .env or in the app's Secrets. The dashboard works without it.
chat_placeholder: Ask about this plan, e.g. what if my budget is half?
chat_thinking: Checking the plan and running the tools…
cmp_sub: Seven setups for {crop} at this site, on {area} m²
diagnostics_note: Light coverage uses growing days. VPD counts daylight hours above the crop limit. Electricity balances each hour with no battery; exported electricity earns zero by default. Thresholds and equipment performance remain estimates.
dust_hours: {n} hours above the scenario threshold out of {total} available hours.
dust_note: Recent CAMS model estimates from Open-Meteo, separate from the typical climate year. These are not a long-term dust forecast or measured site observations.
dust_scenario_note: Illustrative soiling rates affect light, solar output, yield, cleaning cost and water. They are editable CSV assumptions, not measured dust deposition.
dust_unavailable: Dust data unavailable. No exposure estimate has been substituted.
estimate_banner: Prices are FAOSTAT farm-gate prices and water use is calculated from this site's weather. Build costs and crop limits are still estimates, so treat profit and payback as illustrative. See Assumptions.
k_cost_n: Everything needed to build this setup
k_solar_n: Sized for the hottest day's cooling
k_water_n: Crop irrigation plus cooling-pad water, calculated from local weather
l_eyebrow: Farm planning for hot, arid regions
l_hero: Turn desert sun into farms that grow and pay off.
l_sub: Drop a pin on the map. Croptions tells you what to grow and when, which setup survives the heat, how much solar power it needs, and how many years until it pays for itself.
none_budget: The setups that keep crops cool enough cost more than the budget.
none_constraints: No option passes all temperature, light, data and budget checks. Review the detailed reasons below.
none_nodata: No climate data for this site yet.
none_title: No setup works here with these inputs.
none_too_hot: No setup keeps any crop below its heat limit for 90% of the year.
operate_banner: Simulation using satellite climate data for this site. Not live sensor data. Weather is held constant within each hour; the controller updates every ten minutes.
operate_missing: Sunlight data is unavailable. Reanalyse this site with the updated NASA data before running the simulator.
p_empty: Click the map to drop a pin.
p_need_pin: Drop a pin on the map first
p_sub: Pick a site on the map, then tell us about the farm.
plan_updated: Plan updated: the dashboard now shows the new result
pr_payback_n: Earn back the build cost soonest
prices_country: FAOSTAT farm-gate prices for {country}, fetched {date}. Farm-gate is what a wholesaler pays the farmer; shop prices are higher.
prices_world: No site analysed yet, so these are world median FAOSTAT farm-gate prices (fetched {date}). Analyse a site to see its country's prices.
prices_world_site: The country for this site could not be looked up, so these are world median FAOSTAT farm-gate prices (fetched {date}).
profit_sub: Starts at minus the build cost; crosses zero at payback
r_empty_sub: Pick a site on the Plan page, then press Analyse this site.
reason_hold: Hold position to avoid unnecessary movement
reason_protect_light: Open the screen to preserve growing light
reason_reduce_heat: Close the screen gradually to reduce heat
reason_release_shade: Open the screen as the temperature falls
s1: Fetching climate data (NASA POWER, 5 years, hourly)
safe_answer_no_plan: Choose a site on the map and press Analyse first, then ask me about the plan.
safe_answer_none: No setup works for these inputs. {reason}
safe_answer_rec: The recommendation is {setup} for {crop}: it keeps the crop below its heat limit {coverage}% of the year, costs {capex} QAR to build and pays back in {payback} years.
scan_note: Draw a rectangle on the map. Each point fetches climate data and may take a minute; nearby points can share the same coarse satellite grid. Maximum 25 points.
set_edit_hint: To change a value, edit the matching file in data/ and reload. Editing inside the app is planned.
set_note: Every value the planner uses, with its source. Prices come live from FAOSTAT; values marked estimate still need a real source.
share_hint: Anyone with this link sees the same plan.
solar_cap: That day the panels produce {solar} kWh and the chiller uses {cooling} kWh. Cooling at night needs storage or the grid, which the plan does not cost yet.
solar_none: No solar chiller option for this crop.
solar_sub: Solar chiller greenhouse in {month}: {kw} kW of panels vs cooling electricity, per hour
sources_sub: Every number traces back to these
suggest_budget: What if my budget is half?
suggest_crop: Which crop fits this site best?
suggest_water: Which option uses the least water?
temp_cap_none: No setup stays below {limit} °C every month.
temp_cap_note: Monthly averages hide single hot days; the coverage in the table counts every hour.
temp_cap_pad: The wet-pad greenhouse goes above the limit in {months}.
temp_title: Inside temperature vs the heat limit
v1t: Every crop checked month by month against 5 years of hourly climate data for your site.
v2t: Seven setups, including selective heat screens and fixed or movable agrivoltaics, simulated for all 8,760 hours of a typical year.
v3t: Build cost, yearly profit and payback in QAR, sized to your budget.
verdict_nopay: It does not pay back its build cost.
verified: Verified: every number comes from the plan
